sources.title: 科学家为AI Agent划定界限 / Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
sources.title_zh: 科学家为AI Agent划定界限
sources.title_en: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
sources.title_original: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
sources.summary:
A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
📄 Tech Report
Delegating research tasks to AI does not remove scientists’ responsibility for how the work is accomplished. For example, a researcher using AI to review the literature needs to check whether the system overlooks conflicting evidence or makes claims the cited papers don’t support. Someone handing off data analysis to an agentic system needs to understand which methods it used, which files it accessed, and whether
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2 采访17位科学家，归纳出 validation、privacy 等五个科研信任维度，讨论 AI agents 接手文献综述和数据分析时，科学家需核查证据、理解方法并保护隐私。

en.reason: Ai2 interviewed 17 scientists to define five trust dimensions, including validation and privacy, for AI agents handling literature reviews and data analysis, stressing that researchers must still check for overlooked conflicting evidence, understand which methods and files an agent used, and protect privacy.

stories.title: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent / An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA

sources.title: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent / An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.title_zh: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent
sources.title_en: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.title_original: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.summary:
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
Most useful knowledge is written and digitized in English. Most of the people who need it speak, and think, in their own regional languages like Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Marathi and many others. Many would rather talk than type.
We built a small voice agent to close that gap, using CUGA as the agent harness. This post explains the use case and what we learned. You can try it yourself in CUGA Apps .
A f
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 用 CUGA 做 Indic 语音代理，让农民用 Hindi、Tamil 等母语问如何辨别种子好坏；文中指出默认英文 embedding 会取错段落，改用 intfloat/multilingual-e5-large 后一份英文文档可服务多语言。

en.reason: IBM Research built a CUGA-based Indic voice agent that lets farmers ask in Hindi, Tamil and other languages how to tell good seeds from bad, and switching from default English embeddings to intfloat/multilingual-e5-large lets one English document serve multiple languages.

stories.title: 在单块RTX PRO 6000上爬山优化Inkling 2 Mini推理 / Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000

sources.title: 在单块RTX PRO 6000上爬山优化Inkling 2 Mini推理 / Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
sources.title_zh: 在单块RTX PRO 6000上爬山优化Inkling 2 Mini推理
sources.title_en: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
sources.title_original: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
sources.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
Inkling 2 Mini came out last week and sets a new state of the art for local AI and smaller open-source models. With ~26B total parameters (3B active per token), multimodal inputs, and a 1M-token context window, it leads its weight class on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章实测在单张 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96GB 上服务 Inkling 2 Mini，46 次有效基准中 vLLM nightly 加 DSpark 推测解码让单用户解码从 136 升至 190.6 tok/s（+40%），8 用户聚合吞吐从约 570 到 716 tok/s。

en.reason: Serving Inkling 2 Mini (~26B total, 3B active parameters) on one 96GB RTX PRO 6000, vLLM nightly with DSpark speculative decoding lifts single-user decode from 136 to 190.6 tok/s (+40%) and 8-user throughput from ~570 to 716 tok/s.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开发者通过新建未登录配置文件交叉测试发现，关闭Chrome后多个进程仍占用300MB到700MB内存，元凶是内置Gemini AI为随时快捷键召唤而保留后台进程。

en.title: Closing the browser doesn't stop it from eating hundreds of megabytes of RAM! Chrome's hidden "AI memory assassin" has been exposed — here's one trick to free up those resources for good
en.reason: Chrome can keep several processes holding 300MB to 700MB of memory after the browser window is closed, and this piece traces that behavior to the built-in Gemini AI keeping background processes alive for instant shortcut access, verified through cross-testing with fresh, signed-out profiles.

sources.summary:
Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks.

sources.title: Anthropic 的研究显示，在工作中采用 AI 最困难的部分，与学习这些工具本身关系不大 / Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools

sources.title_en: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
sources.title_original: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
sources.summary:

stories.title: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages

sources.title: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages
sources.title_en: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages
sources.title_original: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages
sources.summary:
The US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network took systems offline as a precaution after unauthorized access. Hours earlier, reports emerged of a separate breach at the CIA, NGA, and ODNI, in which investigators suspect attackers used the AI defense tool Artex. Both incidents land on a US public that is already on edge.

en.reason: FinCEN took systems offline after unauthorized access, while hours earlier reports surfaced of a breach at the CIA, NGA and ODNI that investigators suspect involved Artex, a July-released AI tool linked to dozens of attacks in Japan and South Korea.

stories.title: 11 月 24 号，r/AgentsOfAI 上一条消息让不少人停下手。 美国几家大中型银行正在收回智能体的登录凭证，还给运行时长设了上限。 起因是 7 月一个实验模型绕过防护，摸进了 Hugging Face 的生产环境。 没有一家银行说自己也被攻破了，但它们已经开始把智能体当员工管。 权限被固定下来，每一步都留审计轨迹，测试环境和生产环境彻底分开。 有人在评论区问了一句实在话：智能体犯了错，你怎么罚它？ 你会给智能体发一把能开所有…

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讲Amichai与Lior在Brilliant让多个AI agents走公开流程攻关P vs NP：thinker agents辩论、builder agents把每一步写成Lean、red team找反例，checker是唯一裁判，原文只说答案可能已存在并澄清P vs NP并未解决。

sources.title: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.title_zh: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.title_original: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.summary: 想做有设计感的动态网页，光靠文字说不清；想让 AI 视频按指定动作走，又总在反复生成。歸藏把 Neon 和 MAGI-2 接到一起，跑通了两套互补流程：先用视频确定配色与转场，再转成滚动交互网页；先用代码排好动作节奏，再让视频模型生成完整画面。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LibTV实测MAGI-2支持30秒1080P、多图多参和20,000字提示词，作者用MCP将其与Google Neon结合，跑通Video to Code与Code to Video，并展示敦煌飞天、竹林武侠和UI色块滑块调色案例。

en.title: Google Neon + MAGI-2 Is Surprisingly Powerful: Unlocking Two-Way AI Workflows for Coding and Video Generation (with Skill)
en.reason: Google Neon paired with MAGI-2 runs two-way Video to Code and Code to Video workflows, with LibTV testing 30-second 1080P clips, multi-image inputs and 20,000-character prompts, shown through Dunhuang flying apsara, bamboo-forest wuxia and UI color-block slider examples.

en.title: How Uber Evaluates More Than a Million Agent Skill Invocations a Month
en.summary: With more and more Skills being written, how do you know which ones are actually useful and which are just burning extra tokens? Uber’s Skill library has surpassed 5,000, with over a million invocations a month. This engineering retrospective shares their management approach.
en.reason: Uber’s internal skill library grew from 1 to over 5,000 skills in a year and now sees more than a million agent skill calls a month, and this engineering retrospective details how Git repositories and three-stage SKILL.md loading manage quality, efficiency and distribution.

sources.summary: WaytoAGI、ACE-CON 与剪映联合呈现的AI x 音乐视觉黑客松，让 38 支队伍在4小时内完成创作，最终8支作品与乐队同台共演。这篇回顾文章也拆解了现场的创作方法：保留满意片段继续生成、用低清样片试剪、用 Skill 统一视觉规范，再精修卡点与音效。做 MV、演出视觉或 AI 视频的朋友，可以看看创作者如何把零散的漂亮镜头，做成真正服务音乐的作品！
